responsibility: Provides the V850 RTL operand and operator predicates referenced throughout the machine description. These predicates distinguish valid register/immediate combinations, even-numbered registers for multiword operations, call addresses, movsi symbolic operands, small-data and displacement forms, bit-mask constants, canonical floating-point compare conditions, and recognizers for prologue/epilogue and prepare/dispose parallel patterns, thereby controlling which RTL shapes match V850-specific instruction and split patterns in v850.md.
